official_sources.name: Texture Projection Definition Property Editor
official_sources.evidence: Texture-projection UVW transformation exposes Scale U/V/W, Rotation U/V/W and Translation U/V/W; these transform the projection on its support and use the picture bottom-left as pivot. Freeze bakes the UVW transformation into UV coordinates.

official_sources.name: Texture.GetTransformValues
official_sources.evidence: Transformation parameter names include projtrsu/v/w, projsclu/v/w and projrotu/v/w and are part of the texture-effects calculation alongside repeat/remap/crop/wrap state.

official_sources.name: CRotation Class Reference
official_sources.evidence: Euler constructor defaults to RotationOrder siXYZ; siXYZ is explicitly X, Y, Z order.

official_sources.name: Changing the Bones' Order of Rotation
official_sources.evidence: Softimage user documentation describes XYZ as the default Euler rotation order.

archive_evidence.txmp_matrix_fields: post-path +90 stores rotation XYZ in radians, scale XYZ, translation XYZ
archive_evidence.general_xsi_blender_bridge: io_scene_bz2xsi transposes XSI matrices when importing into Blender and transposes Blender matrices when exporting to XSI
archive_evidence.stasis_ascii_binary_correspondence: ASCII diag(-1,1,-1,1) on right-side Stasis meshes corresponds to the old binary +/-pi Y rotation TXMP family
archive_evidence.code400_face39_geometry: inverse support rotation aligns planar-XZ local Y with the textured face normal: abs dot 0.992183 versus 0.152876 for direct application

production_contract_for_code400.column_vector_rotation_matrix: Rz * Ry * Rx (apply X, then Y, then Z)
production_contract_for_code400.projection_coordinate_direction: inverse support pose: object-local geometry is transformed by inverse projection-support rotation before base planar/spherical/cylindrical projection
production_contract_for_code400.matrix_storage_boundary: transpose when bridging XSI row storage to Blender/mathutils convention
production_contract_for_code400.support_scale_translation: retain but do not promote beyond evidence-covered paths; the supplied class-4 nonidentity code400 set has unit matrix scale and zero matrix translation
production_contract_for_code400.code400_code401_composition: none observed in supplied primary corpus; relation paths are mutually exclusive

evidence_boundary: The inverse direction is independently supported by asymmetric class-4 geometry, not only documentation.

The full XYZ order is completed by Softimage's documented default siXYZ convention; the face39 target alone has Y=0 and therefore cannot distinguish every Euler order without that source documentation.
This contract applies to model-local relation code400 projection support. Material-level code401 remains a separate binding path and must be validated at its own application stage.
Future archives with non-default rotation-order metadata, code400/code401 overlap, or class-4 nonunit support scale/translation must be treated as new cases rather than silently generalized.
